text.p: Spacelabs Medical Inc Monday said it signed a definitive agreement to acquire Burdick Inc, a privately owned developer and manufacturer of diagnostic cardiology systems.
In a statement, the company said the acquisition, expected to close in the third or early fourth quarter of this year, will cost approximately $50 million.

The company said it plans to take associated one-time charges primarily for the acquisition of in-process research and development and some restructuring expenses. A spokeswoman for the company said the charges could total between 20 percent and 40 percent of the purchase price, net tangible assets.
Excluding the one-time charges, the acquisition is expected to become accretive within the first year.
On a separate note regarding the recently ended second quarter, the company said it is comfortable with analysts' earnings estimates in the low $0.30 range for the second quarter.
